ui_tap.note: Tiny dry wooden tick, a token set on an oak table. 0.14 s.

unit_select.note: Small brass buckle clink with a soft leather creak: picking up a toy soldier.

invalid.note: Dull, low double knock on a closed wooden chest. Not a buzzer.

sheet_open.note: Crisp rustle of a parchment map being unrolled.

sheet_close.note: Soft fold-and-slide of a parchment sheet. Raw take was very quiet (+29 dB of gain).

page_turn.note: One page of a heavy leather-bound book flipping.

quill_scratch.note: Quill scratching a short line on parchment (for chat Send).

coins.note: A few gold coins dropped on a wooden table, bright clinks settling.

letter_seal.note: Wax seal pressed, then a folded letter slid across a desk.

rival_turn.note: Three soft ticks of a wooden pendulum clock while a rival considers.

end_turn.note: Ship's brass bell rung twice, clear ring-out.

footsteps_grass.note: Three or four quick boot steps on soft grass.

horse_gallop.note: Single horse galloping past on hard dirt, light harness jingle.

ship_move.note: Wooden ship at sea: timbers creaking, waves along the hull.

embark.note: Rowing boat pushed into the water, splash and oar knocks.

unit_recruit.note: One snare-drum flam and boots stamping to attention.

musket_volley.note: Several flintlocks firing almost together, short outdoor echo.

cannon_boom.note: Black-powder cannon: deep boom with a rolling tail.

melee_clash.note: Two quick sword clashes with a scuffle of boots.

unit_dies.note: Musket and helmet dropping with a soft body-fall thud. Short (0.4 s).

city_founded.note: Bright natural-trumpet flourish over a snare roll.

city_levelup.note: Handbells and celesta, quick rising three-note sparkle.

building_done.note: Three hammer blows on wood, then a small bronze bell.

city_wavering.note: Uneasy string tremolo wavering between two notes.

city_flips.note: Quick bright harp glissando landing on a clear bell chime.

siege_begins.note: Field snare roll crescendo ending on a bass-drum hit.

capital_captured.note: Timpani strikes, cymbal crash and a swelling low brass chord.

discovery.note: Harpsichord flourish rising to a bright major chord.

wonder_revealed.note: Soft choir 'ahh' and shimmering strings swelling into a luminous chord.

legend_found.note: Harp glissando, ringing bells and choir: the biggest positive sting.

rumour_setback.note: Low string stab and muffled timpani, dark minor.

fog_lift.note: Soft airy whoosh of wind, mist clearing. Raw take was very quiet (+24 dB).

envoy_influence.note: Soft wordless choir 'ooh' chord with a gentle harp glissando.

tech_discovered.note: Heavy book closing, then one warm bell tone.

war_declared.note: Heavy war drums pounding a slow, ominous rhythm.

peace_signed.note: Gentle church bells tolling softly in the distance.

raid_horn.note: Low animal horn blown once across a valley.

ascendancy_warning.note: One deep bronze bell toll with a long ring-out (also the knell when a power falls).

victory.note: Natural trumpets and timpani with strings, bright major cadence.

defeat.note: Slow descending strings in a minor key, ending on a low held note.

amb_sea.note: Calm open sea: waves lapping a hull, distant gulls, light wind. 19 s seamless loop.

amb_forest.note: Temperate forest: birdsong, leaves in a breeze, distant stream. 19 s seamless loop.

mus_title.note: Lute and baroque guitar open, a recorder brings in a hopeful sea-going tune, strings join and it builds to a stately full statement, then settles. 89 s, ends and restarts after a 2 s breath. (ElevenLabs music_v2_5)

mus_explore.note: Calm pastoral loop: fingerpicked lute, recorder, viola da gamba drone, light harpsichord and pizzicato. 4.9 s intro, then a 124 s seamless loop. (music_v2_5)

mus_war.note: Tense minor-key loop: low string ostinato, harpsichord rhythm, field snare and timpani, an oboe line. 14.9 s intro, then a 79 s seamless loop. (music_v2_5)

mus_victory.note: 30 s triumphant processional: natural trumpets, timpani, strings, harpsichord, ends on a strong cadence. (music_v2_5)

mus_defeat.note: 16 s melancholy piece: slow viola da gamba over soft lute chords, ends quietly. (music_v1)
